name: com.tencent.tinker.loader.hotplug.ActivityStubs$STDStub_06
description: Tencent Tinker and Tencent Cloud Micro Tinker use this Activity when opening a screen added by a hot-fix patch. This slot matches the patched screen’s launch behavior.
disableEffect: If a hot-fix adds a screen that uses this Activity, that screen may fail to launch.
